h1: PI Cognitive Assessment Quiz & Practice Questions
subhead: Take a free practice quiz or point your phone at any PI Cognitive Assessment question for the answer plus a fast explanation — build speed for the real 12-minute, 50-question test.
metaTitle: PI Cognitive Assessment Quiz & Practice | Cambo
metaDescription: Free Predictive Index (PI) Cognitive Assessment quiz and practice questions with instant, explained answers. Verbal, numerical, and abstract reasoning.
whyItWorks: The PI Cognitive Assessment packs 50 questions into 12 minutes across three different reasoning types, so switching gears quickly matters as much as getting any single question right. Cambo answers a practice question instantly so you can drill the pattern for each question type separately.

sampleQuestions.q: Which word is the opposite of 'frugal'?
sampleQuestions.a: Wasteful — frugal means careful with money or resources, so its opposite is spending freely or wastefully.

sampleQuestions.q: If a shape rotates 90 degrees clockwise, and it started pointing up, which direction does it now point?
sampleQuestions.a: Right — a 90-degree clockwise rotation from 'up' lands on 'right.'

sampleQuestions.q: If PENCIL is coded as QFODJM (each letter shifted forward by 1), how would CHAIR be coded?
sampleQuestions.a: DIBJS — shifting each letter forward by one: C→D, H→I, A→B, I→J, R→S.

sampleQuestions.q: A recipe calls for 3 cups of flour to make 12 cookies. How many cups of flour are needed for 18 cookies?
sampleQuestions.a: 4.5 cups — the ratio is 3 cups per 12 cookies, or 0.25 cups per cookie; 18 × 0.25 = 4.5.

sampleQuestions.q: Which word does NOT belong with the others: hammer, screwdriver, wrench, nail?
sampleQuestions.a: Nail — a hammer, screwdriver, and wrench are all tools used to perform work, while a nail is a fastener the tools act on, not a tool itself.

sampleQuestions.q: A sequence of shapes gains exactly one dot each step (1 dot, 2 dots, 3 dots...). How many dots does the next shape have?
sampleQuestions.a: 4 dots — the pattern adds exactly one dot to each successive shape, so the next in the sequence continues that same increment.

faqs.q: What is the PI Cognitive Assessment?
faqs.a: A 12-minute, 50-question test measuring general cognitive ability across verbal, numerical, and abstract reasoning, used by employers to gauge how quickly a candidate can learn and adapt.

faqs.q: What's a good PI Cognitive Assessment score?
faqs.a: Scores are typically reported as a raw score out of 50 alongside a percentile; what's considered competitive depends on the role and the employer's own benchmark.

faqs.q: How is the PI Cognitive Assessment different from the CCAT?
faqs.a: Both are short, high-pressure cognitive tests from different publishers (Predictive Index vs. Criteria Corp) with similar formats — 50 questions, about 12-15 minutes, verbal/numerical/abstract or spatial reasoning.

faqs.q: Is Cambo affiliated with Predictive Index?
faqs.a: No. Cambo is an independent study tool and isn't produced, endorsed, or affiliated with Predictive Index or the PI Cognitive Assessment.

faqs.q: Is the PI Cognitive Assessment timed per question or overall?
faqs.a: Overall — you have 12 minutes for all 50 questions combined, so pacing across the whole test matters more than any single question.

faqs.q: What should I focus on when practicing?
faqs.a: Building speed on the three question types (verbal, numerical, abstract) individually, so you're not slowed down switching between reasoning styles during the real test.
